initial_prompts: Create a standalone landscape game environment furniture concept sheet for BUY BID BLOW, using the attached furniture sheet ONLY as a style/material reference, especially its section 04 tiered tables and chairs. Show ONLY auction audience seating, no podium, no pedestal, no room, no people. Match warm medium walnut timber, restrained brass corner caps, oxblood red felt desktops and upholstered chairs, sturdy stylized bevelled construction, small brass table lamps and X-braced front panels. Cream background, soft studio shadows, premium stylized 3D concept art. One large elevated front-right three-quarter view occupying 80% of sheet, the audience faces toward the foreground bottom of the image; farthest row highest. Also small clean top-down layout inset bottom right. Clearly modelable geometry, functional seat access. Keep comparable camera, lighting, scale and materials across variants. Exactly three seating rows, approximately six seats per row, shallow fan-shaped footprint suitable for the curved rear half of a mezzanine. No exaggerated fortress walls or tall ornate pillars. Text only the supplied title at top. Title: 'A / CONTINUOUS CURVED TIERS'. Three continuous gently curved long desks, one per tier, each arc concave toward the common auction focal point in front. Three shallow stepped platforms, loose individual red chairs behind desks, clear walking strips behind chairs. Stairs on BOTH outer sides with modest brass-capped wood handrails. NO center aisle. Broad elegant continuous horizontal curves.
